applicability: The re-validation of the task entry's changed-intent summary in the dashboard cockpit.
conditions: The cockpit provides IntentEntryRevalidation with shown = Operations view and no takeover; without its provider generation remains zero and revalidate is inert.
Shown transitions and explicit revalidate callbacks advance the shared generation. The entry's facts key carries that generation into its existing summary-read owner.

The mounted live review memory hook calls the same revalidate callback after matching its registered scope/revision; initial/reconnect readiness also reconciles. Closed/recorded reviews do not register.
Read coalescing, conditional retention and superseded-answer admission remain owned by the existing summary hook/store; no unconditional one-network-read-per-notification promise is made.
exclusions: The superseded blanket absence of live memory invalidation or of a knowledge-related signal on the existing state stream.
A second EventSource, an entry-installed poller, or current counts inferred from an unobserved memory operand.
Historical L47 ruling provenance is preserved but does not prohibit R57@v2 rule5's now-implemented invalidation path; no new runtime/performance grade.
statement: The shared entry-generation context retains task-open/re-show/return and explicit-refresh revalidation, and accepts the matching mounted live review's memory-invalidation callback. Memory invalidation uses the existing scoped state stream; the context itself remains local React state, not a second event connection, projection authority or poller.
